== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ヤッグル、ガックル</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">生物と同じ位置にいる乗用生物を目標とする。凶暴性＞目標の回避値＋移動速度なら、乗用生物は食べられる。生物の凶暴性に２を加える（累積可能）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「落ち着け。おい！ 落ち着きなよ。いったい何だい？ 何かを嗅ぎつけたのか？」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Yaggle Gakkle.

'''Lore''' — Calm down. Hey! Calm down. What is it? Did you smell something?

'''Game text''' — Target a creature vehicle at the same location as a creature. If ferocity exceeds the target's maneuver plus landspeed, the creature vehicle is eaten. Add 2 to the creature's ferocity (cumulative).

Title prints a Japanese comma (ヤッグル、ガックル) for the English space. Lore omits English girl and uses 位置 for site. +2 ferocity is a following sentence, not attached to the eaten clause.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-yagglegakkle.gif|Original English face]], [[Yaggle Gakkle]].</ref>
